title: A slice of structs
hints: Range over the slice and read each Item's fields with item.Price and item.Qty. Cheapest returns a second, ok result for the empty case.
Start Cheapest from items[0] rather than from a zero Item, whose price of 0 would beat every real item. Use a strict < so the first of several equally cheap items wins.

Total: sum item.Price * item.Qty. Cheapest: if len(items) == 0 { return Item{}, false }; best := items[0]; loop and replace when item.Price < best.Price. ByName: m := make(map[string]Item, len(items)); m[it.Name] = it.
